regulation_clause.text: Regulated entities must update KYC records in the Central KYC Records Registry within 7 days of receiving updated information from a customer.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 65(8) (footnote-148 insertion into the 2016 MD, now 2025 clause 65(8)) requires CKYCR updates within 7 days of receiving updated customer information (duration_days=7, at_most). KYCSYNC1's WORKING-STORAGE (lines 10-14) has no elapsed-day or date field at all, and 2000-QUEUE-UPLOAD only branches on the boolean WS-UPD-RECEIVED (line 23); there is no 7-day deadline check anywhere in the program's reachable logic.
